sql: WITH modes(mode) AS (SELECT 'dw_only' UNION ALL SELECT 'purchase_negative' UNION ALL SELECT 'purchase_zero_month'), nets AS (SELECT mode,customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount WHEN txn_type='withdrawal' OR mode='purchase_negative' THEN -txn_amount ELSE 0 END) net FROM customer_transactions CROSS JOIN modes WHERE mode<>'dw_only' OR txn_type IN ('deposit','withdrawal') GROUP BY mode,customer_id,m), bal AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) closing FROM nets), lagged AS (SELECT *,LAG(closing) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) prev,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m DESC) r FROM bal) SELECT mode,COUNT(*) customers,SUM(prev IS NULL) null_prior,SUM(prev IS NULL AND closing>0) null_positive,SUM(CASE WHEN prev=0 THEN closing*100.0 ELSE (closing-prev)*100.0/ABS(prev) END>5) abs_no_null_pass,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN prev=0 THEN closing*100.0 ELSE (closing-prev)*100.0/ABS(prev) END>5)/COUNT(*) abs_no_null_pct,SUM(CASE WHEN prev=0 THEN closing*100.0 ELSE (closing-prev)*100.0/prev END>5) signed_no_null_pass FROM lagged WHERE r=1 GROUP BY mode
